_comment: PINNED-klt TIE PROBE -- not signoff evidence. gf180-bandgap#441.
erc-supply-spec.json verbatim, plus the ties[] declaration that klt
0.8.0 (signoff/klt-pin.txt) actually computes erc.missing_tie from.
Its sibling erc-tie-spec.known-gap.json is the SAME declaration as it
was written against klt 0.5.0, kept unchanged as the #2169 history; this
file is what that declaration has to become to say anything at the pin.
Why this is NOT the item 11 citation: it reads the PRE-DR-0007 GDS, and
the citation (plus any manifest change) belongs to gf180-bandgap#358
after #204 regenerates the layout. This file exists so #358 starts from
a measured declaration instead of re-deriving one.
THREE BIAS CLASSES, because one ties[] entry claims every shape on its
well_layer and this block biases Nwell two different ways:
nwell_tap_pmos  Nwell 21/0 MINUS the DRC_BJT 127/5 marker -> vdd
The PMOS band's well. Tapped by ntap.pbias / ntap.top
(plan.py TapItem kind='nwell', net='vdd').
nwell_base_pnp  Nwell 21/0 WHERE the DRC_BJT 127/5 marker is -> vss
The eight vertical-PNP base islands (one per PnpItem in plan.py's
'PNP' row, each a 10.40um square: generate.draw_pnp draws L_NWELL
and a coincident L_DRC_BJT box). Every PnpItem declares
base_net='vss' -- the Nwell IS the PNP base terminal, so biasing
it to vdd would be the bug. Declared as its own entry per klt's
own rule that each bias class gets one (erc.py,
_select_well_class: 'each bias class is declared as its own
ties[] entry with its own net').
psub_tap        top-cell extent MINUS Nwell 21/0 -> vss
The native p-substrate, via well_complement_of (klayout-tools
#3750) because no LVPWELL (204/0) is drawn anywhere in this GDS.
Tapped by ptap.nbias / ptap.ampn plus the p+ guard ring
(floorplan.md section 9).
tap_layer is Comp 22/0 narrowed by tap_requires (klayout-tools#2169) in
all three entries -- Comp n Nplus 32/0 for an n-well tap, Comp n Pplus
31/0 for a substrate tap. gf180mcu has no dedicated tap layer, so
tap_is_dedicated is deliberately NOT affirmed; the narrowing is what
makes the tap region distinguishable from ordinary source/drain Comp.
Declaring the implant alone (tap_layer 32/0, as known-gap.json does)
removes nothing from the drawn layer and klt 0.8.0 correctly refuses it
as erc_coverage.skipped reason 'degenerate_tap_declaration'.
Measured on klt 0.8.0 / klayout 0.30.13 against
layout/bandgap_top/bandgap_top.gds
sha256:97944732...edf055c -- see this spec's committed report and
README.md, 'What is NOT verified here':
gate_count            10   (no #2169 collapse)
erc_coverage.skipped  []   (all three ties COMPUTED)
erc_finding_count     0
One honest caveat the report states itself: psub_tap is listed under
erc_coverage.checked_by_well_assertion, because its region is derived
by complement rather than read off drawn geometry. That is weaker
evidence than a drawn tub layer would be -- but it is a computed check
with a falsifiable region, not the absence of evidence that omitting
ties[] leaves behind.
